verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a REST API reference covering types, paths and request payloads for each operation. Many pages include request and response payload examples, and some show calls via the CLI, Terraform provider or SDKs, which users can run in their own environment. However, no live in-browser try-it runner is documented, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec that interactive tooling could use. Missing for 10: interactive in-page execution of API calls, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and consistent runnable examples across all reference pages (only 'many'/'some' pages have them).
